page_note: 本页为《Health at a Glance: Europe 2024》第185页，仅含一张编号图 Figure 7.5，由五个并列的横向条形小图组成，显示34个国家/地区五类卫生服务的公共与强制保险支出占比，数值全部直接标在条上。

heading.title: Healthcare coverage for selected services, 2022 (or nearest year)
heading.subtitle: Government and compulsory insurance spending as proportion of total health spending by type of services

components.evidence: country names run down the left edge, bars grow rightwards in each of the five panels
"Inpatient care", "Outpatient medical care", "Dental care", "Pharmaceuticals", "Therapeutic appliances" set above each panel
five identical horizontal-bar panels side by side for five service types
the country labels are printed once at the far left and serve all five panels
no numeric tick labels on any panel; only printed percentages such as "90%", "77%"
"N/A" printed where bars are absent: Greece dental and therapeutic, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, Serbia, Finland
the EU27 row is drawn in red/orange in all five panels while other rows are blue
percentages printed on the bars, e.g. "88%" inside Austria's inpatient bar
short bars push labels out: Latvia "12%", Romania "7%", Spain "2%" sit right of the bar
each of the five plot areas carries a light grey fill behind the bars
faint vertical rules and edge ticks inside the grey panels; no horizontal rules between rows
34 country names stacked down one axis, from "EU27" to "United Kingdom"
34 rows x 5 panels minus 7 N/A cells = about 163 bars
"Note: Outpatient medical services mainly refer to..." and "Source: OECD Health Statistics 2024." below the plot
"StatLink" logo with "https://stat.link/1ubzf4" under the source line

new_components.name: group_separator_gap_in_category_axis
new_components.evidence: a blank unlabelled row between "Sweden" and "Bosnia and Herzegovina" splits EU from non-EU countries

new_components.evidence: every printed value carries "%", e.g. "90%", "77%"; no axis or title states the unit symbol

difficulty_notes: 数值本身全部以"90%"、"84%"形式印在条上，读数没有精度问题（第2步不成立，也无刻度标签可用）；真正的瓶颈是定位：10个待测值中有8个在页面上重复出现（例如90%同时属于EU27 Inpatient care、Cyprus Pharmaceuticals、Germany Outpatient；67%出现5次），所以每个值必须同时由国家行名与五个面板名之一（Inpatient care / Outpatient medical care / Dental care / Pharmaceuticals / Therapeutic appliances）联合寻址。解析器若把五个面板压平成一张34行的表而丢掉面板列名，或把面板标题只当作普通文本，就无法区分这些同值单元格；另外Sweden与Bosnia and Herzegovina之间的空行和7处"N/A"也容易让行对齐错位。
